retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban group portrait featuring subjects in formal attire against a corrugated metal backdrop with stencil-style graffiti and a prominent lip motif.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in dark suits posed in front of a corrugated metal wall covered in black graffiti and a large, pink-magenta lip graphic. The lighting is dramatic with a slight magenta color cast in the shadows, creating a contrast between the formal clothing and the industrial, street-art environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Formal suits contrasted against industrial corrugated metal
Central lip graphic acting as a secondary focal point behind the group
Magenta color wash unifying the foreground subjects with the background art
Staggered height composition with subjects standing, sitting, and crouching
coreInvariants: Magenta-pink lip graphic with stencil-style interior

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a triangular formation; two standing on the left, one sitting centrally, one crouching on the right, and one standing on the far right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure and the large lip graphic directly above him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the standing figures on the left, down to the central seated figure, across to the crouching figure, and up to the lip graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with the subjects and the textured background.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and hot pink (lip graphic and color wash)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white shirts and dark suits; high saturation in the magenta accents against a desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or greens
Limit to monochromatic greys, blacks, and magenta tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; secondary logo-like text is integrated into the background graphic.
graphicDevices: Stencil-style cutout text within the lip graphic

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Clean, condensed, and modern for display use.
Matches the square, condensed industrial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of five men in dark suits posed in front of a corrugated metal wall. The wall should have black graffiti and a large pink lip graphic. Apply a magenta color wash to the lower half of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text at the bottom center, overlapping the subjects' legs.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and bold?
Is the magenta lip graphic present on the corrugated wall?
Are the subjects wearing dark suits?
Is the text white and centered at the bottom?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the magenta color wash
Number of subjects in the group
mustRedesign: Do not use specific band logos
Do not replicate specific facial features of the original subjects
Do not copy the exact graffiti tag patterns
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered.
Ensure the corrugated metal texture is visible through the graffiti.
Verify the magenta tint is consistent across the bottom third of the image.
Confirm the subjects' poses feel natural and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Industrial Texture + Stencil Graphic + Condensed Display Type
